The '''Sentient Greatcleaver''' is a type of [[Weapons|Weapon]].

It is the direct Upgrade of the [[Living Cleaver]].

== ''Obtainment'' ==
Sentient Weapons evolve from their craftable Living counterpart after having dealt 50,000 damage.
== ''Usage'' ==

The Sentient Greatcleaver is a Melee Weapon. Its attack reach is 4 blocks in every direction from the players head, which is the default attack reach.

Each time it is swung, it performs a sweeping attack (though only visually if airborne or the attack cooldown is still up) and applies the [[Viral|Viral II]] Effect.
